html:
Coming to Vietnam, you will encounter high mountain ranges, with mountain passes covered in clouds all year round, clear streams that look like a picturesque landscape painting from afar. If you are a nature lover and want to find a trip to explore and conquer high mountain ranges, then come to Vietnam and conquer the top 7 mountains worth conquering.

If you still don’t know which mountain to visit on your upcoming trip to Vietnam, today Vietlook Travel will suggest you the top 7 beautiful mountains to conquer on this trip.

Fansipan Mountain

If you are a travel enthusiast and want to explore famous mountains in Vietnam, Fansipan is the first stop on your trip. This is the highest mountain in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

Fansipan belongs to Hoang Lien Son range with an altitude of 3,143 meters, the climate here is relatively cool in summer, quite cold in winter, if you travel to Sapa on cold days when conquering Fansipan peak you will be immersed in white snow.

You can reach the top of Fansipan by a 6.2km cable car. This is the longest cable car system in the world and is the highlight of the mountain climbing trip.

When you reach the top of the mountain, you can see the whole view of Hoang Lien Son mountain range and admire the beauty of nature.

In addition to mountain climbing, visitors can also experience interesting activities such as mountain climbing, camping or soaking in natural hot water that will bring visitors a feeling of relaxation.
When conquering the mountain top, from the top of the mountain you can admire the scenery of Sapa, a beautiful natural scene with a peaceful rustic picture, especially when the sun has just risen with the first rays of sunlight shining on the canopy when the dew drops still on the leaves will sway in the wind creating a beautiful picture.

To have a great Fansipan trip, you should prepare all the necessary equipment, including climbing shoes, warm and thick clothes, masks and enough drinking water, and plan a trip with good health to conquer the height, while walking and admiring the natural scenery.

Pu Ta Leng Mountain

If you are a lover of wild nature and want to conquer high mountains, visit Pu Ta Leng Mountain, one of the highest peaks in the Hoang Lien Son range in Northwest Vietnam.

If you are a lover of wild nature and want to conquer high mountains, visit Pu Ta Leng Mountain, one of the highest peaks in the Hoang Lien Son range in Northwest Vietnam.

To reach Pu Ta Leng Mountain, you have to cross streams, forests and high hills to reach the top of the mountain. From above, you can see the majestic mountain ranges, villages, corn fields and terraced fields hidden in the misty fog.

What’s special is that Pu Ta Leng is still a fairly new and unexploited destination, so when you come here, you will experience the wildness and peace.

At an altitude of 2,900m above sea level, visitors will admire the rhododendron forests with flowers of various colors such as pink, red, white… Rhododendrons bloom most beautifully in March and April every year. Because if you want to see beautiful rhododendron flowers, you should travel to Sapa from March to April.

If you conquer Pu Ta Leng peak at the end of the year in November, visitors will admire the beauty of the yellow and red leaf forest, you will feel like you are in some western land, not at Pu Ta Leng Mountain.

However, you must also prepare carefully before climbing Pu Ta Leng, including equipment such as climbing shoes, warm clothes, masks, and enough drinking water. You also need to prepare mentally to face the challenges on the way to the top.

Pu Si Lung Mountain

If you spend 2 weeks conquering the mountains, and conquering the beauty of Vietnam, then Pu Si Lung Lai Chau is a destination you must visit, located at an altitude of over 3,000 meters above sea level.

To reach the top of the mountain, you will cross difficult and arduous paths, such as dense forests, hills, rivers and streams, and conquer steep slopes. When you reach the top, you will see the clouds drifting slowly, especially when the sunlight shines in, creating a beautiful scene for you to enjoy from above.

The vegetation is stratified, from low shrubs to tall shrubs. Moreover, the forest has many beautiful flowers, including orchids, rhododendrons and especially lilies that look very unique and rare.

From the top of Pu Si Lung, you can admire the majestic landscape of Hoang Lien Son mountain range, along with the tranquility and peace of wild nature. In particular, you also have the opportunity to explore many rare and attractive species of flora and fauna on the mountain top.

If you are a mountain climbing enthusiast, Pu Si Lung is a destination not to be missed when traveling to Vietnam. This is one of the challenges for you to conquer the height and challenge yourself and have the best tour.

Ba Den Mountain

Ba Den Mountain in Tay Ninh, located at an altitude of about 986m, is one of the destinations with many diverse temples and pagodas such as: Hoa Thanh Temple and Cao Dai Temple to Thuong Temple, Trung Temple, Ha Temple. This is one of the important pilgrimage sites for people in the Southwest region.

Coming here, besides the sacred temples and spiritual activities, visitors can also participate in many interesting outdoor activities at Ba Den Mountain such as: mountain climbing, kayaking on the Dauntings River, mountain biking… this will bring you interesting and challenging experiences when conquering the mountain top.

When reaching the top of Ba Den mountain, you can admire the panoramic view of the surrounding hills and enjoy the scenery of Thien Hau statue, one of the famous architectural works of Ba Den mountain, and learn about the unique culture of the Southern region.

As a famous pilgrimage and tourist destination, Ba Den Mountain has many accommodation facilities, restaurants, and cafes to serve tourists. In addition, you can also buy unique souvenirs to give to friends, relatives, or as souvenirs during your conquest of Ba Den Mountain.

With interesting and diverse landscapes, Ba Den Mountain is one of the tourist destinations that you cannot miss when exploring the famous landscapes in Vietnam. You should visit Ba Den Mountain to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Bach Ma Mountain

Bach Ma Mountain is located 60 km south of Hue. In Vietnam, it is considered a natural boundary, and is located in Bach Ma National Park and is 1,450m high.

This is a resort chosen by many tourists when coming to Vietnam. From the top of the mountain, you can see waterfalls and peaceful streams. It is one of the beautiful destinations with wild, magnificent scenery and many exciting activities.

Below are the activities when you visit Bach Ma Mountain

  • Conquering Bach Ma mountain at an altitude of over 1,400m requires you to have good health and endurance to climb to the top of the mountain. However, when you reach the top, you will feel excited and have unforgettable moments.
  • Bach Ma National Park is located in the middle of a primeval forest and is one of the largest national parks in Vietnam. Coming here, visitors can learn about the diverse ecosystem and rich fauna.
  • Visiting the Forest Church is one of the unique architectural works on Bach Ma Mountain, built in the middle of a lush green forest. This is a place of prayer for those who seek peace and tranquility.
  • Hiking and conquering Bach Ma mountain, visitors go through challenging trails for climbing and hiking enthusiasts passing through lush forests, clear streams and beautiful waterfalls.

When you reach Bach Ma Mountain, you will have to go through winding roads. However, the higher you go, the more the beauty of Bach Ma appears before your eyes and you will be satisfied to admire the beauty of Lang Co Bay.

You can also admire the purple color of sim flowers and enjoy the beautiful lakes at Bach Ma National Park. It will definitely bring you beautiful memories during your trip.

In addition, you will also encounter diverse flora and fauna, colorful landscape paintings will bring you the most enjoyable feelings.

Ba Vi Mountain

Ba Vi Mountain is located about 50 km west of Hanoi city center. With an altitude of over 1,200m, Ba Vi Mountain is covered by a rich primeval forest and is home to many rare species of flora and fauna.

The mountain is considered one of the most beautiful mountains, and is best visited in the fall, from September to November. At this time, the weather is cool and pleasant, not too hot or too cold, along with beautiful and captivating natural scenery.

In addition to mountain climbing experiences, visiting national parks and enjoying local cuisine, visitors can also participate in many interesting activities in Ba Vi.

  • Join the tour and experience cycling and mountain climbing to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Ba Vi mountain and explore the winding passes.
  • Taking part in sports activities like hiking, climbing and ziplining will give you a sense of excitement and help you explore new paths.
  • Admire the beautiful scenery from the top of Ba Vi mountain, you can see the whole town, or the rice fields, lakes and pristine forests.
  • Bathing in the streams and waterfalls at Ba Vi mountain, which are clear, cool and unique, is an ideal stop for tourists to relax and cool off on hot summer days.

In addition to Thuong Temple, visitors can visit other famous landmarks such as Thay Pagoda, Duong Lam ancient village, West Lake, Muong Hoa Heaven Gate,…

To get to Ba Vi Mountain, you can choose to travel by motorbike or car. However, if you are trekking, walking is the best way to experience the mountain.

If you want to stay overnight at Ba Vi Mountain, you can choose a resort or camp or stay at a homestay, there are many options for you.

Ngu Hanh Son Mountains

If you are planning to travel to Vietnam for 2 weeks, you cannot miss a stop like Ngu Hanh Son, and explore the beauty of marble mountains.

The mountain was formed about 5 to 10 million years ago and has 5 limestone peaks, each named Kim Son, Moc Son, Thuy Son, Hoa Son, and Tho Son.

In addition to visiting tourist attractions, visitors can also participate in activities such as mountain climbing, trekking, camping, and taking photos next to beautiful landscapes. Ngu Hanh Son is an ideal destination for those who love natural scenery and want to find peace in nature.

The best time to travel to Ngu Hanh Son is from February to August every year. At this time, the weather is warm and cool, not too hot or too cold, very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee, especially walking to admire the scenery or conquering the mountain top to admire the scenery from above.

To get to Ngu Hanh Son, you have to climb many steps, so you should wear cool clothes, and you should avoid the rainy season from August to November, because storms will affect your tour or conquer the mountain peaks.

In addition to the suggested destinations above, it will help you choose your favorite destinations, especially conquering high mountains from the North, Central, South… and experiencing the culture of each region and enjoying the cuisine of each locality.

Note When Going To Experience Climbing

Mountain climbing in Vietnam is an exciting and challenging activity. You must refer to some tips below to ensure your trip is safe.

Research the mountain climbing destination before going

The first important thing when preparing for a mountain climbing trip is to research the destination you will go to. This helps you know in advance about the location’s height, slope, climate, and weather conditions.

If you are climbing in winter or rainy season, you need to bring the right equipment to ensure safety. At the same time, if you are climbing in a group, make sure that all members know the location well and are fully prepared before conquering.

Consult and choose a reputable travel agency to choose a rewarding trip for yourself. If you are still hesitant, let Vietlook accompany you.

Prepare necessary equipment

The next important thing is to prepare the necessary equipment when climbing. Spikes help you grip the rocky slopes. In addition, a backpack full of food, water and emergency items is also necessary when climbing.

Waterproof jackets, sunglasses, masks and safety equipment such as belts and helmets are also essential items to bring. During the climbing process, essential accessories.

However, if you are afraid of long distances and want to avoid carrying heavy equipment, you can rent from local people or agents.

Good Health

Mountain climbing is an activity that requires you to be in good health. Before starting the trip, check your health and make sure you can complete the journey safely.

Local regulations

Localities may have their own regulations regarding climbing, so it is important to research and follow the rules before you go. If you are traveling with a guide, ask them about the rules and make sure you understand and follow them.

Safety first

Always follow the rules when climbing in Vietnam, do not go alone and always keep in touch with your companions or the authorities to ensure the safety of yourself and others. If you encounter an emergency, seek support from a guide or rescue agency.

Monitor the weather

It is important to check the weather before you go hiking to ensure your safety. If the weather is bad, you should cancel your trip and wait for better weather. If you are hiking and the weather suddenly changes, make sure you have the right equipment to deal with different weather conditions.

Respect local culture

When hiking in Vietnam, please protect the local nature and culture. Do not litter and keep the public clean. Respect and learn from the local culture, avoid causing trouble for the local people, it will not be good for your trip.

It can be said that Vietnam is a beautiful destination for mountaineers who want to explore pristine natural landscapes. From Fansipan, Pu Ta Leng, Pu Si Lung, Bach Ma, Ba Vi to Ngon Hanh Son Mountain – Da Nang, each location brings unique and interesting experiences for you. Let’s join Vietlook to explore the beauty of Vietnam today.
